name: times_eq_mul
prelude:
def times : Nat → Nat → Nat
  | 0, _ => 0
  | n + 1, m => times n m + m
statement: theorem times_eq_mul (n m : Nat) : times n m = n * m
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => simp [times]
  | succ n ih => simp [times, ih, Nat.succ_mul]
  induction n with
  | zero => rw [times, Nat.zero_mul]
  | succ n ih => rw [times, ih, Nat.succ_mul]
